findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: THIS IS A SECOND REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed there is an accumulation of debris on the ice machine baffles. The PIC stated they get the ice machine professionally cleaned every six months, but the inspector suggests a more frequent cleaning schedule. The inspector will return on 11/3/2025 to check that the ice machine has been cleaned to sight and touch. The inspector will call the PIC on 11/3/2025 to schedule a time for the follow-up.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the kitchen freezer has a large accumulation of frost. The inspector recommends increasing the frequency that it is defrosted. Ensure that the freezer is defrosted to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is an accumulation of food residue inside of the pizza ovens. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The pizza ovens that are broken or not used frequently must also be maintained cleaned. Ensure that the pizza ovens are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: Observed there was not a CFPM at the facility when the inspectors arrived. During the inspection a CFPM arrived at the facility. Ensure there is always a CFPM at the facility during all hours of operation.

(A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: Observed there was not signed employee health reporting agreements at the facility. Blank reporting agreements were provided to the PIC during the inspection and signed by all present employees. Ensure that all employees sign the reporting agreements and signed copies remain at the facility.

(A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Observed the triple sink at the bar was testing at 100 ppm (quat) during the inspection. The PIC was educated and another quat tablet was added to the sink. Ensure that sanitizer solutions are always testing between 200-400 ppm (quat). Also ensure that sanitizer solutions are tested on a regular basis using test strips.


4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria:. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: THIS IS A TWICE REPEAT VIOLATION. Observed wet wiping cloths stored on the edge of the triple sink and sitting on counters. Wet wiping cloths must be stored in chemical sanitizer between uses. The wiping cloths were moved into sanitizer solution during the inspection. Ensure that wet wiping cloths remain in sanitizer solution between uses and are laundered daily.

Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Inspector observed that the upper baffle of the ice machine is heavily soiled with mold along the upper edge where water come into contact with the baffle. Because ice and water are considered foods, this surface is a food-contact surface and must be cleaned often enough to prevent mold growth. A follow-up is issued for 11/20/2023 to ensure compliance with food-contact surface cleaning. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PREVIOUS INSPECTION ON 10/20/2022. 

Wet wiping cloths MUST BE stored in SANITIZER between uses. Wet wiping cloths were observed on the bar top, hanging on the edge of the triple sink and sitting in a bucket of water in the triple sink which had no sanitizer (chlorine/quat tested). Ensure that wiping cloths are stored properly at the next routine inspection. 

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTION ON 10/20/2022.

Inspector observed the mop bucket sitting in the kitchen to be full of soiled water with a mop sitting in the upper portion of the bucket. Mopping is not actively occurring in the facility. Mop buckets must be emptied after use and not allowed to sit with soiled water. Ensure that mop buckets are emptied appropriately by the next routine inspection. 

6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PREVIOUS INSPECTION ON 10/20/2022.

The rear of the utility sink in the kitchen has foam type caulking along the back edge. This foam is rough to the touch and provides a poor seal between wall and equipment. Surfaces subject to the entry of food/moisture such as sinks must be SMOOTH, NON-ABSORBENT AND EASILY CLEANABLE. 

The rear of the triple sink has sections of missing caulking. Equipment which is not easily moved such as sink must be sealed in a manner that prevents food/moisture from getting behind the equipment itself. As the sink is not easily removed, it must be sealed to the wall in a manner which prevents moisture and is easily cleanable. 

Ensure that all surfaces subject to food/moisture are SMOOTH, NON-ABSORBENT AND EASILY CLEANABLE by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Inspector observed that there are no paper towels at the bar hand washing sink, they are stored in a cabinet next to the sink which requires opening a cabinet to get to. Hand washing sink must be stocked with paper towels at all times that can be grabbed without touching other surfaces. Operator place paper towels next to the sink. Corrected on site. Ensure that hand washing sink is continually stocked with paper towels at all times that are in reach of the sink. Paper towels were discussed during prior inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The hand sink at the bar was observed to have a bucket with a wet rag inside it sitting inside the basin of the hand sink. Hand sinks may not be blocked at any time and may not be used for any other purposes including but not limited to filling and dumping of containers. The bucket and cloth were immediately removed from the hand washing sink. Continue to ensure that the hand sink is always accessible and that it is not used for anything but hand washing. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

We rags cannot be stored in water that is not used a sanitizing solution at the proper chemical concentration. Ensure that wet/moist wiping cloths are stored in sanitizer solution when not directly being used to wipe surfaces. This is a repeat violation from the previous inspection.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed hot water in lady's restroom to be under little to no pressure. Hot water must be under pressure to allow proper handwashing is possible. Fix handwashing sink following proper Illinois Plumbing Code. 
750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water.
